user.title: Set up LLM Agent
user.description: LLM Agent gives an AI model admin-level control of Home Assistant: it can switch devices (including locks and alarms if you approve), edit configuration and restart Home Assistant. AI models make mistakes. Provider charges are yours. This project is not affiliated with Home Assistant or Nabu Casa and comes with no warranty (Apache-2.0).

data.block_invalid_restart: Refuse restart when configuration is invalid

data_description.backup_before_risky: Make a full backup before installing from HACS or removing an integration.
data_description.protect_sensitive: Blocks reading secrets.yaml, auth and credential storage, databases and files outside the config folder, and blocks token-issuing commands.
data_description.allow_shell: Lets the AI run shell commands inside the Home Assistant container. Off by default.
data_description.price_overrides: Per-model prices in USD per million tokens, keyed by model id, each with input, output and optional cache_read. Example: my-model with input 1 and output 4. Used only for the cost estimate. Built-in prices were checked on {prices_checked}; OpenRouter prices come live from OpenRouter.
data_description.daily_spend_cap: Stop and ask once today's estimated cost passes this amount. 0 means no cap. Models with unknown prices are not counted.

confirm_shell.title: Turn on shell access?
confirm_shell.description: Shell access lets the AI run any command inside the Home Assistant container, including commands that can delete files or break your installation. In 'ask before risky actions' mode you still approve each command. Only turn this on if you know what you are doing.

data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the current key. Not needed for a local Ollama server.
data_description.default_model: Pick a suggestion or type any model id.

storage.title: Storage and spend
storage.description: Saved chats: {chats} ({chat_size}). Undo history: {snapshots} snapshots ({snapshot_size}). Audit log: {audit_size}. Estimated spend today: {spent_today}.

data_description.delete_older_days: 0 keeps every chat. Chats that are running are never deleted.
data_description.clear_undo: Deletes every undo snapshot. Changes made so far can then no longer be undone from the panel.
